hypothesis: Deep learning techniques have shown significant promise in enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of weather forecasting and agricultural yield prediction by leveraging large datasets and advanced neural network architectures. In weather forecasting, models like Pangu-Weather have outperformed traditional numerical weather prediction methods by using deep learning to capture complex atmospheric patterns (pangu-weather_0, pangu-weather_26). Similarly, deep learning models in agricultural yield prediction, such as those integrating satellite and climate data, have improved the precision of crop yield forecasts by using multimodal data fusion and ensemble learning techniques (crop-yield-rs_1, crop-yield-rs_7, crop-yield-multimodal_0, crop-yield-multimodal_4). These advancements demonstrate the potential of AI to transform traditional practices in both fields, offering more timely and accurate predictions (graphcast_11, graphcast_12).
